name: jarvis-editor
description: Lets the Jarvis orchestrator type code live into your VS Code editor.

jarvis.orchestratorUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the Jarvis orchestrator.

jarvis.typeIntervalMs.description: Editor flush interval in ms — how often queued tokens are typed in. Lower is snappier.

jarvis.sharedSecret.description: Shared secret authorising the editor connection. Leave blank to read the token the orchestrator writes to ~/.jarvis/editor-token.

jarvis.tokenFile.description: Path to the orchestrator's editor token file. Blank = ~/.jarvis/editor-token.
